decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution clearly exceeds aspirations: it is used by the UK Home Office in E-borders, connects to over 30 government APIS schemes, and remained prominently presented, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.

The travel health requirements API reports no quantified results, but it kept its own page in 2024 while weaker products were pruned, and it fits the core aviation data offering, so the large firm's slack lets it carry the product despite lower post-pandemic relevance.

The travel and document verification platform survived the 2024 portfolio cut with its own page and complements the core document security and passenger data business, so it appears to meet aspirations well enough to be retained.
